mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Fireman's Park and the First Quarter moon is out. The temperature is 50 degrees, and tonight we expect a low of 40 degrees with no rain predicted. If you are an early riser, the space station will be visible tomorrow at 4:57 AM, rising in the West Southwest over Mount Horeb and traveling over our heads toward the East Northeast.

City news today focuses on environmental efforts and public safety. Property owners can now apply for credits on their stormwater bills by installing rain barrels or gardens. Also, the police department reminds everyone to contact them with any information regarding the O W I arrest of a school bus driver that occurred on October 15.

For those looking to get out and about, Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can participate in trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, and Wednesday offers even more options including pizza specials and additional trivia nights.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. No students were injured during the incident.
The Culver's kitchen is closed for the night. We will be back open tomorrow at 10:00 AM, featuring Devil's Food Cake as the flavor of the day.
